title: helm.authority.narrow.v1 arguments
description: EffectDescriptor.arguments for effect_type helm.authority.narrow.v1: an organization's authority plan that only narrows the one applied, admitted without approval. Every mandate node is one the applied plan has, with terms within its applied terms; a limit is added or lowered, never raised or dropped; effect types are registered or raised, never lowered; principals listed are already registered and may be disabled; a node the plan leaves out is revoked. A plan that would widen anything is refused whole, and nothing is applied. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, and the gateway enforces before admission: no duplicate object keys at any depth; UTF-8 only; the whole document is at most 524288 bytes; principals are listed once each; mandate nodes are listed once each, exactly one has a null parent and its node is the org_ref, every other parent is a node of the plan, and the parents form a tree; every holder is a principal of the plan or one already registered; every effect type a mandate names is listed in effect_types; every child's terms are within its parent's and each of its limits is no higher than the same limit above it; a human the plan may create carries an external_subject, and one that must already be registered is ensure_only; every limit names a mandate node and each mandate has one limit of a given unit, measure, window and span; no principal is both listed and in disable_principals, and no holder of a plan mandate is disabled; valid_until is after valid_from; the target of the effect is the org_ref. amounts, limit values and spans are plain integer literals of at most 9007199254740991, with no fraction, exponent or sign, even where the value is whole; approval_required and risk_classes name only effect types of their mandate's terms; no effect type in terms or in effect_types is a helm.authority.* effect type; the validity window is part of a mandate's terms, so an earlier valid_from or a later valid_until widens; disable_principals lists only principals the applied plan lists, never the requester; the requester is the organization's provisioner, the service principal that requested the plan applied now, and the organization has an applied plan; disable_principals names no human; no effect type is registered or raised, and a class higher than the registered one refuses the plan; The plan digest is the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of this document without base_plan_digest.

org_ref.description: The organization: org:<id>. It is the effect's target and the key of the provisioning the plan updates.

version_ref.description: The organization version the plan was compiled from. Recorded, never interpreted.

stage.description: The activation stage the plan was compiled for. Recorded, never interpreted.

base_plan_digest.description: The digest of the plan currently applied to the organization, or empty when none is. A plan applies only on top of that one (compare-and-set).

valid_from.description: The start of every mandate's validity window.

valid_until.description: The end of every mandate's validity window.

principalId.description: A principal id: the sub of the tokens minted for it. 1 to 255 characters without control characters. The gateway also refuses leading and trailing whitespace.

grantableEffectTypeName.description: An effect type a mandate may grant and a plan may register: not one of the gateway's own helm.authority.* effects.

node.description: A plan node: the name a mandate has in the plan, for example org:<id>, dept:<id>, team:<id> or seat:<id>#g1. A node keeps its mandate across plans while its terms do not widen.

ensure_only.description: Create the principal if it is missing and change nothing if it exists.

targets.description: The allowlisted targets, as exact strings. null allows any target.

approval_required.description: Effect types every call of which needs approval, whatever their risk class.

approval_threshold.description: A call whose amount is at least this needs approval; 0 means every call.

per_call_limit.description: Caps the amount of one call.

condition.description: A CEL condition over input.args, input.target and input.effect_type. It is compiled when the plan is applied; one that does not compile refuses the plan.

risk_classes.description: Raises the risk class of an effect type for this mandate; it never lowers the effect type's.

parent.description: The node this mandate is delegated from; null for the root, whose node is the org_ref.

span.description: The number of window buckets a sliding window covers; 1 when absent. 1 for the windowless and the distinct-value limit.

x-helm.idempotent: conditional: compare-and-set on base_plan_digest; the applied plan applied again changes nothing
x-helm.observable: yes: the applied plan's digest is read back from the organization's provisioning
x-helm.reversible: no: only a provision plan, which needs approval, widens again
